about: The quick start's steps, in order: the one source for docs/quick-start.md's table (render-quickstart.py) and for status.sh. Each step is at most one command or one visit to a page, plus the check that says it is done. check.type is config (fleet.env exists with OWNER and PLAN), verify (verify.sh --only <groups> passes), files (each file is on that repo's default branch, so its starter pull request is merged) or ask (status.sh --mark <id> once you say it is done). link is a kit-relative path to the docs section that explains the step. An optional step is listed but never blocks the next.

steps.title: Write fleet.env
steps.run: `cp bootstrap/fleet.env.example fleet.env`, fill in `OWNER`, `OWNER_TWO` and `PLAN`

steps.title: Create the six repos
steps.run: `bootstrap/create-repos.sh`

steps.title: Store the privacy denylist
steps.run: `bootstrap/set-secrets.sh --only privacy --denylist <file outside every repo>`

steps.title: Copy repo-settings and merge it
steps.run: `bootstrap/copy-starter.sh starter/repo-settings <you>/repo-settings`, then review and merge the pull request

steps.title: Create the environments
steps.run: `bootstrap/create-environments.sh`

steps.title: Create the six GitHub Apps
steps.run: `bootstrap/create-apps.sh` (GitHub's App manifest flow, once per App, in the browser)

steps.title: Install the Apps
steps.run: Open each `https://github.com/apps/<slug>/installations/new` link `create-apps.sh` printed and pick the repos it names

steps.title: Copy the App ids into repo-settings
steps.run: `bootstrap/create-environments.sh` again

steps.title: Drop the example repos from fleet.yml
steps.run: In a pull request on `<you>/repo-settings`, remove the `example-site-*` entries from `repo-settings/fleet.yml` and their rows in `tests/test_repo_settings.py` (unless you have those repos)

steps.title: Copy _agent-guidance and merge it
steps.run: `bootstrap/copy-starter.sh starter/agent-guidance <you>/_agent-guidance`, then review and merge

steps.title: Drop the example repos from repos.yml
steps.run: In a pull request on `<you>/_agent-guidance`, remove the `example-site-*` names from `repos.yml` `cron_coverage.fleet` (unless you have those repos)

steps.title: Copy the two registries and merge them
steps.run: `bootstrap/copy-starter.sh starter/agent-skills <you>/acsi-agentskills` and `bootstrap/copy-starter.sh starter/agent-skills-private <you>/acsi-agentskills-private`, then review and merge

steps.title: Copy skills-evals and wsl-automation and merge them
steps.run: `bootstrap/copy-starter.sh starter/skills-evals <you>/skills-evals` and `bootstrap/copy-starter.sh starter/wsl-automation <you>/wsl-automation`, then review and merge

steps.title: Pin every skills.lock to your registry
steps.run: `bootstrap/regenerate.sh skills-locks`, merge, then run it again for the other four repos

steps.title: Pin the skills-bootstrap hook
steps.run: `bootstrap/regenerate.sh hook-pin`, then merge

steps.title: Pin the scheduled-run-health reusable
steps.run: `bootstrap/regenerate.sh run-health-sha`, then merge the three pull requests

steps.title: Pin the Codex Cloud bootstrap
steps.run: `bootstrap/regenerate.sh codex-pin`, then merge

steps.title: Regenerate the action lockfiles
steps.run: `gh extension install github/gh-actions-lock`, then `bootstrap/regenerate.sh actions-lock` and merge what it opens

steps.title: Decide eval.yml's default fixture
steps.run: `.github/workflows/eval.yml`'s `fixture` default, `evals/workflow-path-audit/required-check-routing`, ships with the kit and runs as it is: keep it, or change it to a fixture of your own in a pull request on `<you>/skills-evals`

steps.title: Apply fleet.yml: protect every repo
steps.run: `bootstrap/apply-settings.sh` (and `--owner <OWNER_TWO>` signed in as that account)

steps.title: Set up each durable machine
steps.run: On each one: `bootstrap/install-machine.sh` (add `--with-codex` if you use Codex)

steps.title: Schedule the machine jobs
steps.run: Windows: `./scripts/register-tasks.ps1` in an elevated PowerShell 7, in your wsl-automation clone; Linux or macOS: `bash scripts/unix/install-schedule.sh <systemd|launchd|cron>`

steps.title: Set up your cloud environments
steps.run: At https://claude.ai/code, give each cloud environment the setup script from acsi-agentskills' `docs/multi-repo-delivery.md` and the network allowlist from _agent-guidance's `docs/reference/network-allowlist-claude-environments.txt`

steps.title: Create the eval runner routine
steps.run: At https://claude.ai/code/routines: an API-triggered routine with the prompt in skills-evals' `docs/routine-prompt.md`; keep the bearer it shows once and its `trig_...` id

steps.title: Store the eval runner's bearer and trigger id
steps.run: `bootstrap/set-secrets.sh --only routine-fire`

steps.title: Optional: let eval.yml trade OIDC for an Anthropic token
steps.run: In the Anthropic Console, set up workload identity federation for `skills-evals`, put its four ids in fleet.env, then `bootstrap/create-environments.sh`

steps.title: Create the fleet worker routine
steps.run: At https://claude.ai/code/routines: hourly at :20, the GitHub connector, the prompt in docs/routines.md

steps.title: Create the prompt-audit sweep routine
steps.run: At https://claude.ai/code/routines: API trigger only; keep its fire URL and bearer for the next step

steps.title: Create the agent changelog watcher routine
steps.run: At https://claude.ai/code/routines: daily at 01:03 UTC, in an environment that holds the sweep's fire URL and bearer

steps.title: Schedule memory curation
steps.run: A weekly task from a claude.ai project thread, and the same on each durable machine (docs/routines.md has both prompts)

steps.title: Create the guidance centralization audit routine
steps.run: At https://claude.ai/code/routines: daily at 08:00 UTC, the GitHub connector, the prompt in _agent-guidance's `docs/routines/guidance-centralization.routine.md`

steps.title: Optional: the project dashboard
steps.run: Follow skills-evals' `dashboard/README.md` (Adopting it), then schedule its refresh every 2 hours
